desc: 透明罐装清亮软胶囊，海洋冷调详情长图，靠通透质地而非宣称
leaf: 深海鱼油软胶囊透明罐装
name: 清亮通透软胶囊海洋款

shots.intent: 首屏用真实水面、贝壳与飞散水滴把「油体清亮通透」这一眼可见的物理事实推给买家，靠质感与冷色海洋氛围赢点击，而不是靠字样宣称。
shots.textZone: upper marine band for one short headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one thin rounded outline pill beneath it carrying three dot-separated label placeholders 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF

shots.intent: 第二屏用一条圆角方框细线图标配对短语，把「为什么选它」压成一秒可扫的四个理由，建立整页的版式母题与视觉节奏。
shots.textZone: four icon captions 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF inside the band; on the pale field one dashed eyebrow 「{callout_5}」, one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one sub-line 「{callout_6}」 in #1F6FA8

shots.intent: 用三段左右交替的圆角切图带，把通透油体、透明罐壁与胶囊形状逐项拆成可核对的结构证据，读作机制说明而不是口号。
shots.textZone: one dashed eyebrow 「{callout_1}」 plus one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 plus one sub-line 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF inside each of the three blocks, photo and text sides swapped per block

shots.intent: 一枚大实心圆盘托住整罐主体、四枚小圆盘挂短语的辐射构图，让视线先落在通透胶囊上再逐点扫读，是一眼看全的结构说明屏。
shots.textZone: one dashed eyebrow 「{callout_1}」 and one centred short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with one sub-line 「{callout_2}」 in #1F6FA8 above the disc; two-line label placeholders 「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」 in #FFFFFF inside the four satellite discs

shots.intent: 极低角度掠射微距让光穿过胶囊壁，用可见的通透度与表面张力承担全部品质证明，替代任何数字与检测话术。
shots.textZone: one thin #1F6FA8 hairline bar in the lower left carrying one short label placeholder 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF

shots.intent: 左右同器同光双栏，只改变内容物的清浊状态，让买家自己看出通透与浑浊的差别，用画面差异代替口说无凭。
shots.textZone: one short label placeholder per panel 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 in #1F6FA8 under each dish, one short headline bar 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF inside a solid #1F6FA8 tab above the panels, one numeral-free label in the centre badge 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把罐子放进清晨餐桌的真实日常里，用水杯做尺度锚点，让买家把自己代入「放在桌上每天看见」的场景而不是功效想象。
shots.textZone: left clean space for one short headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F6FA8 stacked over three short label chips 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF inside solid #1F6FA8 pills

shots.intent: 正侧轮廓配合实色标签页加线框取值格的参数表，把规格疑问一次答清；所有取值留成空位由商家回填，杜绝编造数值。
shots.textZone: one dashed eyebrow 「{callout_1}」 and one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F6FA8 at the top; the six label tabs read 「{callout_2}」 through 「{callout_7}」 in #FFFFFF while every paired value box stays empty; one note-panel heading 「{callout_8}」 in #1F6FA8 above empty ruled lines

shots.intent: 同款三罐等距并列配三枚短语胶囊，让买家在同光同角度下比较数量与搭配，收口选择成本。
shots.textZone: three short label placeholders 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF inside the three pill chips, one dashed eyebrow 「{callout_4}」 and one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F6FA8 centred above the row

shots.intent: 收口屏把产品压回深海蓝实色场，用一枚空按钮与三格空信任位承接店铺自证信息与下单动作，页面闭环但不编造任何背书。
shots.textZone: pale upper band for one short headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F6FA8 with one dashed eyebrow 「{callout_1}」; one empty rounded button area carrying 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF inside solid #1F6FA8; three empty rounded proof frames carrying 「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 in #FFFFFF

style.backgroundSystem: only three background planes across the whole set: a rippling water-surface marine field #1F6FA8 for the claim and closing screens, a flat pale ice-blue card field #EAF4FB for the infographic screens, and a seamless clean white card plane #FFFFFF for the framed identification and variant screens; every screen uses exactly one dominant plane, optional full-width marine blocks #1F6FA8 stacked on the pale field, no gradient, no sky, no beach scenery, no tropical leaves, no marble, no warm beige paper, no wood table
style.direction: cool marine deep-sea softgel detail-page infographic commerce
style.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms at one uniform stroke weight inside rounded-square outlines #FFFFFF on the marine band; solid #1F6FA8 filled circles carrying one number or a two-line short label; hollow #FFFFFF circles with a small #1F6FA8 numeral used as step badges overlapping the photo panels; one small flat fish-and-bubbles silhouette in #1F6FA8 used once per screen as the section marker; no 3D icons, no photoreal icons, no gradient fills, max six per screen
style.lightingSystem: cool 6500K bright daylight-style studio light, broad key from the upper left, crisp specular highlight travelling through the transparent wall and skimming the water surface, small clean droplet sparkle, defined but soft contact shadow that always grounds the product on the wet shell edge, never a warm cast, never a flat shadowless beauty-light look, never a hard flash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool marine deep-sea softgel detail-page ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a deep marine blue #1F6FA8, a pale ice-blue card field #EAF4FB, a clean white card plane #FFFFFF and one warm gold graphic accent #F2A32C used only for hairlines and highlight marks; cool tone throughout; cool 6500K bright daylight-style studio lighting with a broad upper-left key, crisp specular highlight travelling through the transparent wall, small clean droplet sparkle and a defined soft contact shadow that always grounds the product, never a warm cast; one modern geometric sans-serif only, deep marine blue #1F6FA8 lettering on light fields and clean white #FFFFFF lettering on the marine field, a dashed eyebrow line above every headline, one solid #1F6FA8 label tab paired with one thin-outlined #1F6FA8 value box, one solid corner tab with a vertical dotted rule at the right edge; thin-line pictograms of one uniform stroke inside rounded-square outlines plus solid #1F6FA8 filled circles for numbers and short labels plus one small flat fish-and-bubbles silhouette as the once-per-screen section marker; backgrounds limited to a rippling water surface #1F6FA8, a wet pale shell-and-rock edge #EFEAE0 and flat #EAF4FB or #FFFFFF card planes, one dominant plane per screen, no gradient, no tropical leaves, no marble, no warm beige paper, no wood; stable product scale and a consistent upright or gently tilted 3/4 jar attitude with the transparent wall, cap and label unchanged and the fill always glossy and translucent never opaque or recoloured; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand mark, no QR code, no membership badge.
noDrift: no warm brown or beige paper cast
no tropical leaves, sand or ocean horizon scenery
no opaque matte or recoloured fill, no redrawn jar or label
no visible brand mark, QR code, membership badge or contact detail
style.presentationRules: the jar keeps one consistent upright or gently tilted 3/4 attitude at stable scale across the set; the transparent wall, the cap and the label placement stay exactly as in the reference; the pieces inside stay glossy and translucent with light passing through them, never opaque, never matte, never pastel and never recoloured; loose pieces outside the jar are pooled only on the marine screens and never more than a handful; every product rests on a real contact shadow; text overlays never cross the label
style.surfaceSystem: wet pale shell-and-rock edge #EFEAE0 with clear moving water #1F6FA8 for the marine screens, matte pale ice-blue board #EAF4FB for the infographic screens, glossy clean white board #FFFFFF for the framed screens, pale blue linen table mat #DCE9F2 for the single lifestyle screen
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif throughout; headline and label placeholders in deep marine blue #1F6FA8 on light fields and in clean white #FFFFFF on the marine field #1F6FA8; every section headline is preceded by a short dashed eyebrow line and followed by one smaller sub-line; a solid #1F6FA8 rectangular label tab always pairs with one thin-outlined #1F6FA8 value box; a small solid #1F6FA8 corner tab with a vertical dotted rule sits at the right edge of each infographic header; headline 28-48pt, sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; no serif, no calligraphy, no handwriting, no condensed display face
